description: Search Greek public-procurement acts across THREE cross-linked sources — Διαύγεια, ΚΗΜΔΗΣ (Central Electronic Public Procurement Registry) and EU TED. Filter by source (diavgeia|kimdis|ted), lifecycle status (request|tender|award|contract|payment), buyer or supplier ΑΦΜ (9-digit tax id), CPV code, EUR budget range, NUTS region, submission deadline (deadline_after=TODAY + status=tender ⇒ the OPEN tenders a supplier can still bid on), free-text q over the act title, and procurement signals (published facts from ΚΗΜΔΗΣ): direct_award (απευθείας ανάθεση), single_bidder (≤1 bid on the contract), cancelled. Returns a paginated envelope; 'next' is the next PAGE NUMBER or null. Natural-person counterparties are redacted. Summing amount_net across results double-counts, because one procurement appears at several stages; rank_entities and spend_by_cpv count each procurement once.

cancelled.description: only acts the source marked as cancelled

deadline_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only acts whose submission deadline is on/after this date. Pass TODAY to get OPEN tenders — the ones a supplier can still bid on. Combine with status="tender".

direct_award.description: only direct awards (procedure = απευθείας ανάθεση) — a published ΚΗΜΔΗΣ fact

has_chain.description: only acts linked into a reconstructed lifecycle chain (request→tender→award→contract→payment)

page.description: 1-based page number; pagination DEPTH is capped per plan

price_only.description: only awards/contracts decided on lowest-price alone (award_criteria = Βάσει τιμής / Χαμηλότερη Τιμή), excluding most-economically-advantageous (MEAT) criteria

q.description: free-text search over the act title

region.description: NUTS region code prefix, e.g. EL30 (Attica), EL52 (Central Macedonia). Matches by prefix, so EL3 covers all of Attica.

single_bidder.description: only contracts where ≤1 bid was submitted (maxBidsSubmitted; single bidder)

year.description: 4-digit issue year, e.g. 2026 — restricts to acts issued that year

name: search_tenders

amount_check.description: JSON verdict when the published amount looks wrong, e.g. {"outcome":"scale_suspect","original":809100000}

award_procedure.description: statutory exception (art. 32 ν.4412/2016) the buyer invoked to skip a competitive call. Published on ~100% of «negotiated without prior publication» / «competitive procedure with negotiation» / «competitive dialogue» acts and on ~0% of others — so null means NOT REQUIRED, not missing, except on those three procedures where it is a genuine anomaly.

chain_id.description: lifecycle chain this act belongs to, null if unlinked

contract_budget_net.description: the document's own approved budget — compare with amount_net to spot cumulative/typo figures

id.description: canonical act id — Διαύγεια ΑΔΑ, 'kimdis:<ΑΔΑΜ>' or 'ted:<publication-number>'

procedure_type.description: Ν.4412 procedure as published (Απευθείας ανάθεση, Ανοιχτή διαδικασία, …)

redacted.description: true when the counterparty is a natural person (GDPR)

source_url.description: permalink to the authoritative source record

supplier_afm.description: 9-digit ΑΦΜ of a company supplier; a pseudonym "Φ-XXXXXXXXXX" for a natural-person contractor; null when the counterparty is a redacted natural person

next.description: next page NUMBER, or null when there are no more pages — not a URL

title: Search Greek Procurement Acts
